title: Classifying and Tracking International Aid Contribution Towards SDGs

live_model.evidence: "GPT-4 Turbo uses in-context learning for inference"; Table 4 row "GPT-4 Turbo 0.7407 0.8049 / 0.7381 -" (Precision/Recall/F1/AUROC).

prompt.location: Sec. 4 ("Decision-Driven Attention"), Table 3 (goal definitions used to build the prompt)
prompt.note: Baseline uses in-context learning with the same 17 SDG goal definitions (Table 3) used elsewhere to build prompts; no literal prompt template is quoted for the GPT-4/GPT-4-Turbo baselines specifically.

data.source: OECD Creditor Reporting System aid-activity records (151,832 documents gathered by the authors; OECD CRS data is public, but the authors' specific curated/labeled split is not confirmed released)

notes: Test set is a 1/4 split of 151,832 gathered documents (~37,958 items); exact test n is not restated next to Table 4, so n_items/cost are approximate (est_calls assumes ~37,958 x 3 seeds). GPT-4o-mini is used separately, non-comparably, inside the paper's own model's text encoder.
